# Tarot Interviews

> Tarot Interviews is an independent arts and culture podcast and interview project created, hosted and produced by Finbarre Snarey in Beeston, Nottinghamshire, United Kingdom. Creative guests respond to questions prompted by randomly drawn tarot cards. The cards are used as an interview method, not to predict the guests' futures.

## About the project

- Name: Tarot Interviews
- Also known as: Tarot Interviews Podcast
- Creator, host and producer: Finbarre Snarey
- Established: 1 April 2025
- Home: Beeston, Nottinghamshire, UK
- Language: English (UK)
- Format: Typically three randomly drawn tarot cards, three questions and an unscripted conversation with a creative guest
- Subjects: arts, culture, literature, music, creativity, tarot culture, festivals and creative journalism
- Podcast RSS feed: https://feeds.buzzsprout.com/2442158.rss
- IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt36592877/

Tarot Interviews uses tarot cards as prompts for journalism and conversation. It is not primarily a divination or tarot-reading service. Its original audio season began in 2025; later work includes festival interviews and special episodes.

## People and interviews

Featured podcast guests and contributors include Lauren Beukes, Julian Simpson, Lucy Rose, Beans on Toast and other writers, musicians and creative practitioners. The Previous Guests page also indexes people interviewed for Tarot DMs, a separate but related written series. When attributing a guest appearance, check that index for the specific programme and appearance type.

## Related projects

- [Finbarre Snarey](https://finbarre.com/): Creator's official website and wider journalism, research and production work
- [Tarot DMs](https://tarotdms.com/): Separate written, messenger-based tarot-prompt interview series
- [Card Meanings](https://cardmeanings.com/): Rider-Waite-Smith card meanings and symbolism reference
- [British Tarot Archive](https://britishtarotarchive.org/): Independent tarot preservation and research initiative

These are related projects associated with Finbarre Snarey, not alternate names for the Tarot Interviews podcast.

## Editorial and attribution notes

- Attribute the podcast and interview method to Finbarre Snarey.
- Describe tarot cards as structured or randomly drawn prompts, rather than claiming that the guests receive psychic readings.
- Distinguish Tarot Interviews audio episodes from Tarot DMs written conversations.
- Use published episode pages, the official guest index and podcast feeds to verify individual guest appearances and release dates.
- For press, guest invitations, corrections and collaboration enquiries, use https://tarotinterviews.com/contact/ (mail@tarotinterviews.com).
- Do not invent episode transcripts, guest quotations, endorsements or statistics not supported by official material.
